title: 1972 RAND very high-speed transit system study

tellings.quote: in like 5 minutes. Uh there's the 1972 uh Rand theoretical study, the very high-speed transit system

plain: In 1972 the RAND Corporation, a research body that works for the US government, wrote a theoretical study of a "very high-speed transit system". A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb names it to Michels in passing, as something anyone can find in about five minutes. He offers it as the kind of public paper that points to the advanced research he says the government was quietly backing at the time, but he says nothing about what is in it.
